about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Senior Fullstack Developer, data engineer, and pragmatic builder.
body: I'm Dicki Prasetya, a Senior Fullstack Developer with 4+ years of experience shipping production software across the whole stack - backend APIs, database design, frontend interfaces, data pipelines, and deployment. I work mainly with .NET, React/Next.js, Node.js, and Golang on SQL Server and PostgreSQL, and I care about things actually working in production.

What I'm good at: turning complex business workflows into practical systems, building role-based access and reporting/export features, automating email and notifications, and self-hosting everything I build - including this portfolio, a resume builder, and a POS platform I manage end to end. I learn by shipping, and I'd rather deliver something measurable than over-promise.
principles: Design before code - scope first, so the build is deliberate.
Own the full lifecycle: database, backend, UI, deployment.
about.cta: Open to senior fullstack and data-focused roles, including remote. Let's talk.
